'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[Gaza war]]
***[[2025 Gaza Strip aid distribution killings]]
****[[Israeli Defence Forces|Israeli forces]] kill four [[Palestinians]] seeking [[humanitarian aid]] at a [[Gaza Humanitarian Foundation]] site near the [[Netzarim Corridor]] in the [[Gaza Strip]]. ****At least 64 Palestinians are killed by [[Israel]]i planes and tanks at the eastern and northern outskirts of [[Gaza City]] as Israel presses ahead with its plans to seize the city. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cvg478y8l09o (BBC News)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-pounds-gaza-city-suburbs-vows-press-with-offensive-2025-08-24/ (Reuters)]

***[[Israeli attacks on Yemen (May 2025–present)|Israeli attacks on Yemen]]
****Ten people are killed and 102 others are injured, including 21 critically, in Israeli [[airstrike]]s targeting the [[Houthis]] in [[Sanaa]], [[Yemen]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/aug/24/israeli-strikes-hit-yemen-capital-in-retaliation-for-earlier-missile-attacks (''The Guardian'')] [https://apnews.com/article/israel-gaza-yemen-houthi-rebels-sanaa-248e1f1309776330eaf80939fb652220 (AP)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Prisoners of war in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[Russia]] and [[Ukraine]] swap 146 prisoners from each side after mediation by the [[United Arab Emirates]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/russia-and-ukraine-stage-new-prisoner-exchange-after-uae-mediation-5311541 (CNA)]
*[[Terrorism in Belgium]]
**One person is critically injured in a stabbing attack at a [[Palestinian nationalism|pro-Palestinian]] demonstration in [[Brussels]], [[Belgium]]. A suspect is arrested, with a political motive still under investigation. [https://www.euronews.com/my-europe/2025/08/24/person-stabbed-in-central-brussels-after-pro-palestine-demo (Euronews)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Terrorism in Norway]]
**[[Killing of Tamima Nibras Juhar]] 
***An 18-year-old Norwegian man with [[Germans|German]] background is arrested for killing a 34-year-old female welfare worker at an institution in [[Oslo]], [[Norway]]. The [[Norwegian Police]] are treating it as terrorism with a [[racist]] and [[right-wing extremist]] motive as the perpetrator has expressed [[Islamophobic]] views. [https://www.thelocal.no/20250825/norway-teen-suspected-of-terrorism-after-social-worker-murder (''The Local'')]
*Five people are killed, including one perpetrator, in two cases of [[filicide]] in [[Santo Domingo]], [[Dominican Republic]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/four-children-killed-by-parents-in-dominican-republic-police/ (CTV News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Venezuelan political crisis]]
**[[2024 Venezuelan presidential election protests]]
***[[Venezuela]]n [[Venezuelan opposition|opposition]] figures and civil society groups report that authorities released 13 [[Political prisoners in Venezuela|detainees]] held after the disputed [[2024 Venezuelan presidential election|2024 elections]], with some freed outright and others placed under [[house arrest]], while around 1,000 people remain in custody according to [[Human rights in Venezuela|human rights]] organizations. [https://apnews.com/article/nicolas-maduro-political-prisoners-venezuela-election-president-b105d40ed698735f9c77f50f130b134e (AP)]
*[[Gaza war protests]]
**[[Gaza war protests in Australia]]
***An estimated 300,000 people across [[Australia]], including at least 100,000 in [[Melbourne]], march to protest the Israeli escalation of the Gaza war and its plans to militarily seize the entirety of [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]], while also calling for the [[Australian government]] to [[international sanctions|sanction]] Israel. [https://apnews.com/article/australia-gaza-protests-4353dbcf2b21493c0323d113ab9cec4c (AP)]
